name: Total Wireless (Total by Verizon)
notes: Researched from public totalwireless.com pages and the support.totalwireless.com knowledge base (rendered with a headless browser; no sign-in, no payment started). Total Wireless (Verizon Value) is prepaid with a monthly payment date. Sign-in takes a phone number, serial/SIM number or email, then Continue, then the password (loginSteps 2; the engine accepts the phone only). Make a payment works without signing in by entering the phone or serial number (guestLookupFields [phone], guestLookupExact). Payments use credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover), debit cards or PayPal, plus the Total Wireless Wallet ($5-$250 per add, $1,000 cap) and Total Rewards points (minimum $5 on a card); no bank account option is documented, so billing.methods [card]. Auto Pay charges the selected method on the payment date and earns one $5 Auto Pay discount per account on current plans. Not documented, left not_applicable (inferred): paper bills, payment plans, future-dated payments. No cancel step is documented: service ends if the plan is not paid (cancel_service not_applicable, inferred). Plan prices are the published one-line monthly prices with Auto Pay (the plan page lists the first month at $5 more); reviewer changed them from the first-month prices.

labels.username: Phone number, serial number or email

guest_pay.note: Pay without logging in: enter the phone number or serial number of the line, then pay with a credit or debit card.

autopay.note: Auto Pay charges your selected payment method on your payment date each month. Current phone plans get one $5 Auto Pay discount per account.

autopay_cancel.note: Manage Auto Pay from the Pay tab in My Account.

scheduled_payment.note: Payments are charged when you make them; Auto Pay pays automatically on your payment date.

paperless.note: Total Wireless is prepaid and does not mail bills; your payment date and history are in My Account.

payment_arrangement.note: Total Wireless does not offer payment plans. Wallet funds and Total Rewards points can cover part of a payment.

cancel_service.note: There is no contract to cancel: if your plan is not paid by the payment date, service stops. Turn off Auto Pay to stop charges.

pay_by_mail.note: Total Wireless does not take mailed payments; pay online, in the app, by text to 611611, in a store or by calling 1-866-663-3633.

help.title: How do I sign up for Auto Pay?
paragraphs: Auto Pay lets Total Wireless charge your selected payment method automatically on your payment date each month.
All current phone plans get the Auto Pay discount except some legacy plans, limited to one $5 discount per account.
If your Wallet holds money, Auto Pay uses the Wallet balance first and charges only what is left to your card.
steps: Open the Pay tab and select Sign up for Auto Pay.
To change the card later, go to Account & Payment, then Payment Methods, and add a new payment method.

help.title: Total Wireless Wallet
paragraphs: The Wallet holds money for plans, devices and accessories. Add funds with a credit card (Visa, Mastercard, American Express or Discover), a debit card or PayPal: at least $5 and at most $250 per addition, up to 25 times in 30 days, with a $1,000 balance limit.
When you pay, the Wallet balance is applied first and the amount due is what is left for your card. Total Rewards points can cover part of a plan once per cycle if at least $5 is paid by card.

help.title: Total Wireless plans
paragraphs: One-line monthly prices with Auto Pay: Total STARTER $35, Total MAX 5G $50 and Total ALL ACCESS $60. The first month costs $5 more ($40, $55 and $65) before the Auto Pay discount starts. The MAX 5G BYO plan has its own Auto Pay offer.
